description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the 'Packager' plugin for the WPEFramework. It defines the class methods, initialization, deinitialization, and request processing logic for the plugin, including handling install and synchronize repository requests.

classes.name: Packager
classes.description: Main class implementing the Packager plugin's functionality for initialization, request handling, and cleanup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up the service, and creates a package implementation instance.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources, including unregistering the notification and terminating remote connection.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently, it returns an empty string.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently a placeholder with no implementation.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes incoming web requests, handling 'Install' and 'SynchronizeRepository' commands, and returns appropriate responses.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a remote connection is deactivated.
